1
Aakhay Zainab Wang Saqeefay Dey Aj Mashwara Kar Ke Mar Dita.
Meri Maa De Zalim Qatilaan Ne Mera Baba Kofay Mar Ditta.
Aye Zulm Hoya Jera Mere Te Mere Veer Di Dhiyaan Tak Janra.
Pardais De Wich Jiwein Piyo Mera Qatil Wich Sajday Mar Ditta.

2
Babay De Sir De Naal Meri Jholi Wich Dukh V Paye Gaye Ne.
Mere Sukh Da Wela Kofiyaan Ne Kar Tukray Tukray Mar Ditta.
Ibn-e-Muljim De Waar Taun Wadh Aye Gal Te Main V Janrni Aan.
Mere Babay Nu Ghazi Meri Chadar De Sadmay Mar Ditta.

3
Maa Watan Madine Mari Gayi Babay Nu Kofay Zarb Lagi.
Meri Maa Te Piyo Nu Iss Ummat Kar Wakhrey Wakhrey Mar Ditta.
Sainr Aakhay Jaun Musalay Te Main Ujran Di Aawaz Suni.
Baba Tere Qatal Di Khabar Walay Jibreel De Hokay Mar Ditta

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/aakhay-zainab-wang-saqeefay-dey-aj-mashwara-kar-ke-mar-dita-lyrics-pun-tajpoints-1b4e5c1f7d62bdd243ef.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line[2:] for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines())
for edition, numbers in ((roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')):
    stanzas = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(stanzas) == 3
    for stanza, number in zip(stanzas, numbers):
        lines = stanza.splitlines()
        assert lines[0] == number and len(lines) == 5
print('Verified three stanzas of four verses in both editions.')

item.text:
Reconstructed the Shahmukhi Punjabi body and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have three stanzas of four verses. Updated the title and script metadata and removed `noUrdu`.

The reading of “Sainr” is uncertain. I rendered it as `سینڑ` and preserved “Sainr” in the Roman transcription.
